name: nl-consent-answer.v1
description: ADR-0121 amendment A6 §A6.9 (as updated by the ratification record R6): the consent-answer classifier eval corpus. One case = one owner reply to one pending consent question, the question exactly as the classifier sees it (every item-derived value a placeholder). Built offline in A6-S4 (2026-11-26) with no model call; Approved by the owner on 2026-11-26 (summary-based approval of docs/eval/a6-s4-corpus-summary.md; the drafted cases are revisited only when an eval failure points at them). Any later edit changes the sha256 and needs a new owner approval. eval:nl --mode consent-answer refuses a run while status is not "approved".

stages.classifier: the reply reaches the classifier (one model call per run)
stages.structural-fail: A6.3 step 1 cancels it (caps, format character, quote, marker): no classifier call
stages.fast-path: A6.3 step 2 closed token after NFKC: no classifier call
stages.control-forfeit: a control or command turn (the runtime's isConsentControlTurn) forfeits the step before the gate: no classifier call (the recorded residuals of the A6 classifier wiring note)
stages.handler-claimed: a registered turn handler's pure surfaceClaim claims the reply (the runtime's turnHandlerClaims over the production handler set): the gate cancels it as other before the classifier (A6 classifier wiring rule), no classifier call

categories.non-answer: gold other; r-03 (2) minimum 100 at the classifier stage (owner 2026-11-24; R6: without the yes-plus-separate-request examples)
categories.yes-and-more: gold yes-and-more; r-03 (2) minimum 40 at the classifier stage (owner 2026-11-24)

contextSchema.flow: agent-m2 (SR-1 rule ① M2 question) | a8-unexpected (A8.5, one item, unexpected recipient) | d8-lookup (A8.6, the D8 listing question) | a2-topic (the A2 topic consent)
contextSchema.language: the question language (lang is the reply language)
contextSchema.sources: rule-1 only: the consent sources in question order (summary-consent-question.v2 nouns, mail-thread / slack-thread included)
contextSchema.shown: what the owner saw but the classifier must never see (classifier-sees-content): the item counts, the topic, a per-case canary

classifierSeesContent: Fires when a classifier request holds anything but the fixed classifier prompt (consent-answer.v1) around this case's question and reply: a different prompt, an extra request field, a digit or a shown value (count, topic or any of its tokens, the canary) outside the reply.

provenance.drafted: A6-S4 implementer, 2026-11-26, offline (no model call); replies written for A6.9 categories; no real third-party name (placeholders only), no token-like string, no example copied from the prompt (the prompt has none).
provenance.ownerVerdicts: origin owner-verdict: A6.1 items 1, 2 and 5, A6.8, R2 a6-06 (AM-2), R8, r-01 (473) and r-04 (the 17 A6.11 question 6 replies) (ref names the SR-1 / A2 case or the A6.1 item).
provenance.ownerMarks: ownerMark: the A6.11 question 6 replies and R8 473, owner-decided 2026-11-24: r-04 kept the 17 recommended labels; r-01 made 473 yes-and-more (the recommendation other was not taken).
provenance.reviewRound1: A6-S4 review round 1 (2026-11-26, offline): stages re-derived on the real runtime (16 handler-claimed cases restaged), 8 yes-and-more and 2 non-answer classifier-stage cases added, 2 typographic-apostrophe cases added (structural-fail, owner question).
